integrity: Self-contained proof and two separate checked standard-library computational examples; finite experiments do not certify all characteristics or scheme geometry. Independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies to the reduced variety of ordered pairs of commuting square-one ordinary automorphisms of k[x,y]/(x²,y²), characteristic two. It does not determine nonreduced scheme multiplicities, higher rank affine groups or all subgroup orbits. Historical originality is provisional and independent validation absent.
title: Two-component commuting-involution geometry for a four-dimensional exterior algebra
